title: Guest chat
entryHint: No sign-up needed. The conversation stays in this browser and expires after 24 hours; it is never synced to an account.
memoryWarning: In this stage the conversation lives in page memory only: refreshing or closing the tab loses it, and it is never synced to an account.
empty: Type a message to start chatting.
placeholder: Type a message. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
noModels: No guest model has been opened by the administrator yet.
requestFailed: Request failed, please try again later.
disabled: Guest chat is currently disabled on this site.
sessionExpired: The guest session expired. Refresh the page to start again.
budgetExhausted: Today's guest budget is used up. Please try again later.
globalBudgetExhausted: The site-wide guest budget is used up. Please try again later.
quotaExhausted: Today's guest generation quota is used up.
rateLimited: Sending too fast, please slow down.
concurrencyLimited: Too many guests right now, please retry shortly.
modelNotAllowed: This model is not open to guests.
inputTooLarge: The input is too long. Please shorten it.
lastCost: This call was charged to the guest budget.
